meta.templateNote: Read-side counterpart to workflow 10 — pulls processed leads back out via the app's already-built public API (app/api/v1/leads/route.ts) into a free Google Sheet a sales team can browse/filter, instead of waiting on a push event. No app-side code changes needed. Requires an API key issued at /admin/api-keys (drk_live_... prefix, shown once) pasted into a Header Auth credential named 'AveronAi API Key (Leads Export)' — header name Authorization, value 'Bearer drk_live_...'. Also requires a Google Sheets OAuth2 credential ('AveronAi Google Sheets') with edit access to the spreadsheet at AVERONAI_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID, and a 'Leads Export' tab with a header row matching the Code node's output columns (id, name, leadType, status, buyerScore, confidenceScore, propertyTypes, locations, budgetMin, budgetMax, budgetCurrency, whatsapp, phone, email, assignedToName, createdAt, latestAppearanceAt). The Code node paginates internally (no more single-page-only limitation) and persists a lastRunAt watermark in this node's static data — do NOT rename or replace this node without carrying that state over, or the next run re-pulls everything from epoch. Rate-limited per the company's plan (plans.apiRateLimitPerMinute/apiRateLimitBurst); a 429 mid-pagination throws and the whole run retries next tick from the same cursor, which is safe (upsert-by-id) but wastes the pages already fetched — acceptable at MVP scale.
